title: U.S. House, District 27
what_it_does: Represents Florida's 27th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives; votes on federal laws and spending.
verified_ballot_note: Roster from CBS Miami, Local 10 and WLRN post-primary reports: Maria Elvira Salazar (R) vs. Eliott Rodriguez (D). No NPA candidate identified; absence unconfirmed. Sources: https://www.cbsnews.com/miami/news/2026-florida-primary-district-27-republican-maria-elvira-salazar/ ; https://www.local10.com/news/politics/2026/08/18/florida-primary-coverage-of-us-house-races-for-the-27th-congressional-district/ ; https://www.wlrn.org/government-politics/2026-08-18/ex-tv-anchor-eliott-rodriguez-27-district Florida adopted a new congressional map (passed Apr 29, 2026, signed May 4, 2026) that reworked 21 of 28 districts; county descriptions here reflect post-redistricting reporting where found (https://www.wusf.org/politics-issues/2026-05-06/breakdown-changes-for-florida-new-congressional-map).

candidates.name: Eliott Rodriguez
candidates.occupation: Retired broadcast journalist (former CBS News Miami anchor)
candidates.background: Eliott Rodriguez, 69, is a retired broadcast journalist who anchored at CBS News Miami for 25 years; he was born in New York to Cuban parents. He left the station and announced his candidacy in March 2026, then won the Aug. 18 Democratic primary with about 53.5% over former homicide prosecutor Robin Peguero. Coverage describes affordability and opposition to the Trump administration's immigration policies as central themes of his campaign.
candidates.primary_result: Won Aug 18, 2026 Democratic primary with ~53.5% over Robin Peguero (CBS Miami; WLRN)
